title: Green Markdown settings
description: config/settings.json — hot-reloaded by every open window. Keep in sync with src/settings.ts.

theme.description: CSS file inside the config dir to use as the theme, e.g. "theme.css" or "themes/serif.css".

bulletChar.description: Bullet marker written on save. "auto" reuses the marker most common in the file ("-" for new files).

hardBreak.description: How Shift+Enter line breaks are written: two trailing spaces or a trailing backslash. "auto" reuses the file's existing style (spaces for new files).

blockHandle.description: Show the +/drag handle beside blocks and the "/" command menu.

selectionToolbar.description: Show the formatting toolbar when text is selected.

placeholder.description: Hint text shown in an empty document.
